title: Godot freeze when editing color property in floating window on Wayland
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8], v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6], v4.5.beta7.official [4ebf67c12], v4.5.rc1.official [08e9e6b29]

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu, 04 Sep 2025 23:18:13 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB (nvidia; 580.82.07) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600X 6-Core Processor (12 threads)

### Issue description

When editing a color property in a floating window (like the advanced import options window or a floating inspector) the engine can freeze and become fully unresponsive. This appear to only happen in Linux Wayland as it was tested on Window 10 and on Linux mint with X11 and the bug did not happen there. It can be any color property and does not have to be a color property for a material.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fdcbb510-4665-4ce1-af0d-e50142f36e69

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/74dd8193-173e-4b9d-8482-1f4be06d87ca

### Steps to reproduce

1. Be on linux wayland
2. Edit a any color property in a floating window (like a floating inspector)
3. Click, hold and drag around the color selector and do not let go of the mouse
4. Within a minute or so godot should freeze and become fully unresponsive

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[color_freeze_bug_mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22223614/color_freeze_bug_mrp.zip)
